data.description: ### 1. Technical Environment * **code_version:** $(git rev-parse HEAD) * **Context Scope:** worktree-20260502-222551, preplanning for epic 09b0-1d25-1a7d-4cf1 ### 2. Incident Overview * **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior #### Expected Behavior `.claude/scripts/dso ticket link <src> <target> depends_on` should complete within a few seconds and return exit 0. Link operations are simple append-only JSON event writes that should not require full graph traversal. #### Actual Behavior `.claude/scripts/dso ticket link 1d13-e106-cf55-4273 c742-dc83-fd8e-4c89 depends_on` exits with code 144 (timeout) after exceeding the ~73s Claude Code Bash tool ceiling. The command never returns. Running multiple links in a chained command also times out. Observed during preplanning story dependency wiring (9 link operations needed). ### 3. Action History and Workarounds * **Steps Taken:**   * Attempted: `.claude/scripts/dso ticket link 1d13-e106-cf55-4273 c742-dc83-fd8e-4c89 depends_on` → exit 144   * Attempted: chained 9 link commands → exit 144   * Attempted: `time .claude/scripts/dso ticket link ...` → command backgrounded by user before completion * **Known Workarounds:** Run links in background (run_in_background=true) to bypass Bash tool timeout ceiling. ### 7. Additional Details Ticket store has grown large (~16K tickets). Suspected root cause is that the link command performs expensive graph traversal or validation that scales with ticket store size, but this is not confirmed (Zero Inference Rule — documenting symptom only).
data.title: ticket-cli: ticket link command -> exits 144 (timeout >73s) for valid tickets
